hero.title: MORE THAN A LABEL.
hero.description: A home for artists, ideas and sounds that refuse to stay inside the lines.

intro.title: SOUND SHOULD MOVE YOU.
paragraphs: Quantum Frequency Records exists for music that creates a reaction. Music that makes you stop, listen, think, feel and come back for another listen.
We are building a home for artists and sounds that live beyond traditional boundaries — from rock and country to electronic, industrial, alternative, psychedelic and everything in between.

items.title: DISCOVER
items.text: Find the sounds, ideas and artists that make people stop listening to everything else.

items.title: HARNESS
items.text: Turn creative energy into music, identity and experiences that people can connect with.

items.title: NURTURE
items.text: Build worlds around artists rather than simply releasing songs.

items.title: SUCCEED
items.text: Create opportunities for great music to find the audience it deserves.

difference.title: NO SINGLE SOUND DEFINES US.
difference.paragraph: QFR is intentionally genre-fluid. Our roster can move from country rock to nu-metal, progressive rock to electronic music, psychedelic rock to punk and beyond.
difference.statement: THE ONLY RULE IS THAT IT HAS TO SOUND LIKE SOMETHING WORTH HEARING.

technology.title: WHERE TECHNOLOGY MEETS CREATIVITY.
paragraphs: Quantum Frequency Records embraces new creative technology as another instrument in the creative process.

Our catalog includes artists and music created through AI-assisted workflows, including music developed with generative tools such as Suno. These tools allow us to experiment with voices, arrangements, sounds and entire musical identities at a scale that would have been difficult to imagine only a few years ago.
But technology is not the destination. The music is.
technology.statement: USE THE TECHNOLOGY. CHASE THE IDEA. SERVE THE SONG.

mission.title: BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE WANT TO RETURN TO.
mission.paragraph: Every release is an opportunity to create another doorway into the QFR universe. Our goal is to build a catalog that rewards discovery and artists that feel like they belong to something larger than a single song.
mission.statement: CREATE MUSIC. BUILD WORLDS. LEAVE A FREQUENCY BEHIND.

cta.title: READY TO EXPLORE?
cta.text: Discover the artists, music and stories that make up Quantum Frequency Records.
